2021: In November 2021, in Hammamet, the committee of experts (inspectors and teachers) appointed by the Tunisian Ministry of Education since 2019 for the elaboration of a national referential on comprehensive sexuality education, finalised and validated this referential in order to present it to the Minister of Education for final adoption and to be used in schools in 13 pilot regions starting from the school year 2022-2023.
